query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_patients FROM person

text: 성별에 따른 환자 수 분포를 보여줘
query: SELECT gender_concept_id, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM person GROUP BY gender_concept_id ORDER BY patient_count DESC

text: 제2형 당뇨병을 진단받은 환자 코호트를 추출해줘
query: SELECT DISTINCT person_id FROM condition_occurrence WHERE condition_concept_id = 201826

text: 2021년부터 2023년 사이 연도별 외래 방문 건수를 보여줘
query: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM visit_start_date) AS visit_year, COUNT(*) AS visit_count FROM visit_occurrence WHERE visit_concept_id = 9202 AND visit_start_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM visit_start_date) ORDER BY visit_year
SELECT DISTINCT person_id FROM drug_exposure WHERE drug_concept_id = 1503297

text: 고혈압과 제2형 당뇨병을 모두 진단받은 65세 이상 환자 코호트를 추출해줘
query: SELECT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE (2024 - p.year_of_birth) >= 65 AND p.person_id IN (SELECT person_id FROM condition_occurrence WHERE condition_concept_id = 316866) AND p.person_id IN (SELECT person_id FROM condition_occurrence WHERE condition_concept_id = 201826)

text: 제2형 당뇨 환자의 HbA1c 평균값을 성별로 비교해줘
query: SELECT p.gender_concept_id, AVG(m.value_as_number) AS avg_hba1c FROM measurement m JOIN person p ON m.person_id = p.person_id WHERE m.measurement_concept_id = 3004410 AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL AND m.person_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT person_id FROM condition_occurrence WHERE condition_concept_id = 201826) GROUP BY p.gender_concept_id

text: 2023년에 처음으로 고혈압을 진단받은 환자 코호트를 추출해줘
query: SELECT person_id FROM (SELECT person_id, MIN(condition_start_date) AS first_dx_date FROM condition_occurrence WHERE condition_concept_id = 316866 GROUP BY person_id) t WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_dx_date) = 2023

text: 입원 환자의 평균 재원 기간은 며칠이야?
query: SELECT AVG(visit_end_date - visit_start_date) AS avg_length_of_stay FROM visit_occurrence WHERE visit_concept_id = 9201 AND visit_end_date IS NOT NULL

text: 제2형 당뇨 진단 후 30일 이내에 메트포르민을 처방받았고, 가장 최근 HbA1c가 7.0 이상인 환자를 조회해줘
query: SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p JOIN (SELECT person_id, MIN(condition_start_date) AS first_dx_date FROM condition_occurrence WHERE condition_concept_id = 201826 GROUP BY person_id) co ON p.person_id = co.person_id JOIN drug_exposure de ON p.person_id = de.person_id AND de.drug_concept_id = 1503297 AND (de.drug_exposure_start_date - co.first_dx_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 JOIN (SELECT person_id, value_as_number AS latest_hba1c FROM measurement m1 WHERE measurement_concept_id = 3004410 AND measurement_date = (SELECT MAX(measurement_date) FROM measurement m2 WHERE m2.person_id = m1.person_id AND m2.measurement_concept_id = 3004410)) latest_m ON p.person_id = latest_m.person_id AND latest_m.latest_hba1c >= 7.0
scenario_name: 당뇨 진단 후 메트포르민 처방 + HbA1c 고위험 환자
